title: ₹93.70 today — ₹100 by June? #Shorts
description:
The Indian rupee just hit its strongest level in 6 months. But two major banks can't agree on where it goes next.

Record low: ₹96.96 (May 2026)
Today: ₹93.70 — a 3.4% recovery

What drove the comeback:
→ Crude oil fell 24% ($118 → $90/bbl)
→ FIIs bought ₹53,739 Cr in 8 days
→ RBI opened $133B swap window

What the analysts say:
GTRI: ₹92–93 if crude stays low
Axis Bank: ₹100 by June 2027
UBS: ₹96 by Mar 2027, ₹100 by FY28

Watch crude prices, FPI flows, and US Fed rates — these three factors decide the rupee's next move.
